title: CW: technical details - CISA added four CVEs to KEV: CVE-2026-123158 (OpenSSH, "SSHole"), CVE-2026-102895 (GPUStack), CVE-2026-11

CW: technikai részletek — A CISA négy CVE-t vette fel a KEV-be: CVE‑2026‑123158 (OpenSSH, "SSHole"), CVE‑2026‑102895 (GPUStack), CVE‑2026‑11

via Mastodon https://linuxmint.hu/hir/2026/11/a-cisa-figyelmeztet-aktivan-tamadjak-az-openssh-gpustack-freeswitch-es-ibm

CVE-2026-123158.evidence: CISA added the OpenSSH SSHole flaw to KEV; the Hungarian report covers the Nov 9 KEV update.

CVE-2026-102895.evidence: CISA added the GPUStack authentication bypass to KEV; the Hungarian report covers the Nov 9 KEV update.
